name: Plan B autonomous feature extraction / single-seed CMERC / raw-input pilot

data_policy.inner_dev: fixed previous Train Dialogue grouped holdout used for checkpoint selection; no gradient/refit
data_policy.official_validation: only frozen-baseline final metrics and same120 raw-input pilot; no tuning
data_policy.test: not indexed, trained, inferred, or evaluated; legacy shared containers may deserialize but permitted fields only are indexed
data_policy.speaker_ids: retain official IDs including disclosed single historical MELD Train556/utt6 inconsistency
data_policy.MELD_text: raw CSV exact DialogueID/UtteranceID; one legacy pkl text mismatch explicitly recorded
data_policy.missing_audio: MELD Train125/utt3 damaged, Val110/utt7 absent; retain rows; zero768 embedding and separate missing mask; no legacy-audio imputation

text.loss: supervised CE on Train Fit labels; original native classification head
text.scheduler: 10% warmup then linear decay over fixed10epoch update budget
text.tokenizer: public slow RoBERTa byte BPE BOS0 PAD1 EOS2; right padding/truncation; add_prefix_space=False
text.preprocessing: IEMOCAP unchanged; MELD ASCII removal following reference; no whitespace/case normalization
text.features: last4 BOS[-1,-2,-3,-4] each1024, raw scale without extra norm
text.keep: one best classifier plus one latest full resumable training state

audio.decode: fixed ffmpeg source entire utterance track, no crop
audio.normalization: official zero mean unit variance per entire utterance before chunking
audio.chunking: <=30s whole; >30s nonoverlap30s, tail shorter than400 samples merges into previous; no discarded content
audio.pooling: sum final hidden vectors over all real convolutional frames / total frames, 768d
audio.missing: zero embedding + explicit metadata mask; retained all rows

visual: official features unchanged; no visual perturbation

downstream.core: frozen XP04 core math, causal=False; audioinput768, text4x1024, officialvisual dims
downstream.difficulty: new M3Net on TrainFit only; five positive true-class logprob removal gaps plus speaker term, official formula
downstream.CMERC: fresh random model; newdifficulty only; preserve original CC rank + MSCL + CSCL + curriculum and XP04 coefficients
downstream.old_assets: no old checkpoint, old M3Net weights, old difficulty, old T/A features
downstream.selection: maximum inner-dev macro-F1, patience10; no officialVal checkpoint selection
downstream.loss_class_weights: source-pinned original XP04 fixed hyperparameters, disclosed as historical constants; no currentTest access or Val estimation
downstream.SCL_nonfinite: record raw pre-fallback nonfinite and fail rather than silently replace

pilot.sampling: fixedseed class/Dialogue/correctness/confidence stratification; audio-available target pool; keep entire contexts and missing rows elsewhere
pilot.mode: frozen extractors and CMERC; targetutterance one modality only; complete Dialogue forward; all others bitwise unchanged
pilot.audio_qc: 16000Hz, exact sample count, RMS preserved, clipping/distortion logged; emotion-preservation uncertainty separate, never claim automated objective QC proves label preservation
pilot.text_qc: review original context/emotion, source unchanged, no original-content truncation, token-identical or uncertain variants flagged; preserve failures
pilot.flip: mean_k[1(argmax p_k != argmax p_clean)] separate frommu
pilot.JS: mean natural-log Jensen-Shannon divergence between clean and each perturbed distribution
pilot.aggregation: per perturbation type, K reported; do not treat different types as equivalent repeated draws
pilot.statistics: correct/wrong separately; confidence bins width0.1 fixed; overlap strata comparisons with support/NA; shared paired Dialogue bootstrap2000; no fitted reliability/calibration model
pilot.interpretation: stratified120 is not population performance; singleSeed exploratory; historical randomfeature comparison cannot isolate perturbation effect across different models

forbidden: public weights or full media/features upload
